ह्रेषुक: ह्रेषुक ह्रेषुक, MBh. 3, 8871, An instrument for digging with (?).
ह्लप्: † ह्लप् ह्लप्, ह्रप् ह्रप्, i. 10, Par. To speak (cf. क्लप् and लप्).
ह्लस्: † ह्लस् ह्लस्, i. 1, Par. To sound (cf. ह्रस्).
ह्लाद्: ह्लाद् ह्लाद्, i. 1, Ātm. To be glad or delighted, MBh. 1, 3036. Caus. To delight, Rām. 2, 44, 10. -- With आ आ, Caus. To delight, Nal. 21, 8. -- With प्र प्र, To be delighted, Kir. 11, 8. Ptcple. of the pf. pass. प्रह्लन्न, Pleased, glad. Caus. To delight, Rām. 1, 9, 56; Pañc. ii. d. 63; Vikr. d. 149 (Ātm.). प्रह्लादित, Rejoiced. -- Cf. κέχλαδα, καχλάζω; A.S. glaed, glad, gladian; O.H.G. glat, splendens (cf. ह्रा̆दिनी, ह्लादिनी).
ह्लाद: ह्लाद ह्लाद् + अ, m. Pleasure, joy.

ह्लीकु: ह्लीकु ह्लीकु,  I. (= ह्रीकु), adj. Bash-ful, modest.  II. m.  1. Tin.  2. Lac.

ह्वान: ह्वान ह्वान, i. e. ह्वे + अन, n. Cry.  -- Comp. कु-, n. disagreeable cry, Bhāg. P. 1, 14, 14.
ह्वृ: ह्वृ ह्वृ (originally ध्वृ, q. cf.), ह्वॄ ह्वॄ, i. 1, and ii. 9, ह्वृणा, णी, Par. To be crooked. -- Cf. Lat. curvus, varus; κυρτός, κύρβεις; Goth. hvairbạn; A.S. hwearfian (Caus.), hwerfa, hweor-fan; hwealf, hwealfa; ἐρέϕω.
ह्वे: ह्वे ह्वे, i. 1, Par. Ātm. (in the Vedas also हू हू),  1. To call, Rām. 2, 34, 11; Chr. 289, 4 = Rigv. i. 49, 4 (अहूषत, ved. aor.); Chr. 288, 14 = Rigv. i. 48, 14 (जुहूरे, ved. red. pf.).  2. To name, Kumāras. 1, 26.  3. To invoke, MBh. 1, 4944.  4. To challenge, to vie with (with acc.), MBh. 3, 1823 (शशिनं ह्वयन्ती, Vying with the moon). Ptcple. of the pf. pass. हूत, Summoned, invited.  Comp. पुरु-, adj. invoked by many, or much in-voked. -- With आ आ,  I. Par. (in epic poetry also Ātm., Rām. 2, 91, 12).  1. To call, Rām. 2, 58, 1.  2. To invoke, Rām. 2, 91, 12; Lass. 101, 3 = Rigv. vii. 16, 1 (आ हुवे, ved. pres.); Lass. 101, 7 = Rigv. vii. 16, 3 (आ जुह्वान, ptcple. pf. pass.).  3. To invite, Man. 3, 27.  4. Rāmac. 146, 2. -- Cf.
